boss_aggro: ATTENTION VIEWERS: Premium content detected. Ad-free deaths available with Dungeon+.
A Guardian engagement has begun. Sponsors, your logos are being polished as we speak.
This encounter is brought to you by nothing, because this crawler reads licenses.
Ratings spike detected. Do NOT disappoint the demographic, crawler.
Boss fight initiated. Our actuaries have adjusted your life expectancy accordingly.
level_up: Crawler stats adjusted upward. This growth was made possible by viewers like you.
Congratulations. Your market value has increased. Your soul remains unlisted.
Level up recorded. Legal reminds you that power gained in-dungeon is non-transferable.
Personal growth detected. Monetizing it now.
sponsor_drop: SPONSOR CRATE INBOUND. Contents legally distinct from happiness.
The audience loves you today. A crate of appreciation is falling toward your general area.
Engagement metrics exceeded projections. Deploying merchandise.
A sponsor has taken interest. Do try to die photogenically near their branding.
floor_warning: REMINDER: This floor is scheduled for cost-optimization. Please conclude your business efficiently.
Facilities announcement: this floor's maintenance budget expires soon. So might you.
The floor manager has noticed you lingering. The floor manager is not paid to be patient.
cost_cutting: Cost-cutting initiated. Redundant crawlers will be made redundant.
Efficiency wave deployed. The System thanks you for your continued attrition.
Downsizing in progress. You are the department being downsized.
barefoot: Our sensors indicate NO FOOTWEAR. Sponsors are horrified. And strangely intrigued.
Crawler continues to operate without boots. Updating the liability waiver.
The footwear lobby has filed a formal complaint about your bare feet.
Podiatric analytics: concerning. Audience sentiment: inexplicably positive.
idle_mock: Viewers are noticing a lack of content. Content is your job, crawler.
Standing still is not a monetizable activity. Exceptions apply for dramatic pauses.
The audience did not tune in to watch you appreciate the architecture.

fan_lines: You fight like my third hatchling. That's a compliment. Sending snacks!
I've watched every crawl for 400 cycles. You're the first one who reads the walls.
We voted and you're our favorite. Don't tell the Vulture.
My whole pod does the fist thing now. Solidarity from the gas nebula!
Please stop getting hit. My translator renders your pain as opera.
hate_lines: You'll never beat the market. Nobody beats the market. I AM the market. Block me.
The Vulture carried that floor and you know it.
Unsubscribed. Re-subscribed to watch you fail. Unsubscribed again. Watching though.
My HOA and I are rooting against you.
This crawl is anti-business propaganda and I cannot stop watching.
obituaries: The System thanks crawler for their engagement. Their organs have been recycled into content.
A moment of silence, sponsored by no one, because silence doesn't sell.
Crawler's final metrics were excellent. Shame about the crawler.
Cause of death has been clipped, remixed, and monetized. Rest well, crawler.
The audience rates this death 4.6 out of 5. Deductions for insufficient slow motion.
